Have you ever wondered how a seemingly small fire can become catastrophic in moments?
In this video, we look at the 1987 King’s Cross fire in London and break down the science of fire investigation, from burn patterns to airflow and computer simulations. Learn how the unique shape of the escalator shaft caused flames to defy gravity and how this tragic event reshaped fire safety engineering, leading to major changes in public transport safety.
